$comment: The mechanisms, other than OPA rules, that count as an automated method for a Key Security Indicator (FRC-CSX-VVK), and the stages at which scripts/_ksi_methods.py observes them. An OPA rule counts through its own annotations (custom.ksi_ids, custom.resource_types), never through this table. Each entry is one of the mechanisms the strict review of 2026-11-06 judged to test the KSI's measures and that runs in this repository today; the rest of that review's table (audit-log review, recovery exercise, CodeQL and ZAP clocks, conformance, availability, the inbox, training) waits until its mechanism is built. policies/compliance/ksi.rego decides the count.

methods.measure: Every package in this inventory's SBOM is scanned against a fresh vulnerability database and the scan passes the detection gate.
GitHub's dependency advisories for this repository are read and pass the detection gate.
The Terraform is scanned by Checkov and tfsec and both results pass the detection gate.
The daily runtime re-validation of live configuration reports no divergence from the deployed inventory.
Live AWS is enumerated and reconciled against the published inventory; any unlisted or drifted resource fails.
Every Terraform change is evaluated by the OPA gate before it is applied, and this deploy's signal carries the passing run.
